description: Redraws ONE cast member's portrait (the same character, a new image) and attaches it to that member: ONE image generation, not a new cast. WHEN: the user dislikes a member's face, or a portrait FAILED (the story create refuses a cast with a failed portrait and names this). `character_id` is the member's `id` from `generate_cast_portraits` or `list_characters` (kind `cast_member`). It draws the SAME character from its stored look: for a CHANGED character (smaller, older, a different thing) use `describe_cast_member`; never re-draft the whole cast to change one member. THE CARD: this call already put the aicut cast card up, each portrait filling in as it generates: do not poll or call `show_generation` (one `get_image` read of `portrait_image_id` if asked). No card (a terminal)? Poll each `generating` member's `portrait_image_id` with `wait_for_generation` (media `image`) and give the urls. AFTER: returns `portrait_image_id` with `portrait_status: "generating"`; the old portrait stays in the account's images. Each repeat is one more portrait's price, stated every time. COST: one standard image at `image_model` (or the platform default portrait model), NOT necessarily the rate the draft published (the library does not record which model drew a face); `estimate_only: true` gives the exact number. THE GO THIS ONE NEEDS: one redraw, one named member, one priced ask: a complaint ('the husband looks wrong') is a reason to OFFER it with its price, never a go; never redraw more members than named. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

character_id.description: The cast member's library id: `id` on a `generate_cast_portraits` member or on a `list_characters` entry of kind `cast_member`.

image_model.description: Image model: the member's OWN `image_model` from `generate_cast_portraits` (matches the cast and its price). Omitted, the platform default portrait model is used: maybe a different look and price.

name: regenerate_cast_portrait
title: Redraw one cast member's portrait
